newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Metway board okays merger proposal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Metway board okays merger proposal.

text.p: Metway Bank Ltd said its directors have unanimously supported the proposed merger with Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) and Suncorp Finance, which are both owned by the Queensland state government.

"We believe the benefits will flow by progressively combing banking, insurance, superannuation and funds management to make the group more profitable and a stronger competitor in the evolving Australian financial service sector," chairman Frank Haly said in a statement.
An independent experts report by Grant Samuel and Associates said the merger was fair and reasonable.
Grant Samuel estimated the merged Suncorp-Metway group to have a market capitalisation of A$2.2 billion.

The Queensland government holding in the merged group would be between 71 percent and 100 percent depending on the number of ordinary shareholders who elect to receive cash rather than retain their shares.
The government currently owns 10 percent of Metway.
The Queensland government has said it intends to reduce its shareholding to less than 15 percent within five years.
